verses: Aey kapray mein lipatnay walay
Raat (kay waqt namaz) mein kharay hojao magar kum
Aadhi raat ya uss say bhi kuch kum kerley
Ya uss per barha dey aur Quran ko thehar thehar ker (saaf) parha ker
Yaqeenan hum tujh per boht bhari baat unqareeb nazil keren gay
Be-shak raat ka uthna dil jamaee kay liye intehaee munasib hai aur baat ko boht durust ker denay wala hai
Yaqeenan tujhay din mein boht shughal rehta hai
To apney rab kay naam ka zikar kiya ker aur tamam khalaeeq say kat ker uss ki taraf mutawajha hoja
Mashriq maghrib ka perwerdigar jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, to ussi ko apna kaar saaz bana
Aur jo kuch woh kahen to sehta reh aur wazedari kay sath unn say alag thalag reh
Aur mujhay aur unn jhutlanay walay aasoodah haal logon ko chor dey aur unhen zara si mohlat dey
Yaqeenan humaray haan sakht biriyan hain aur sulagti hui jahannum hai
Aur halaq mein atakney wala khana hai aur dard denay wala azab hai
Jiss din zamin aur pahar thar-thara jayen gay aur pahar misil bhar bhari rait kay telon kay hojayen gay
Be-shak hum ney tumhari taraf bhi tum per gawahi denay wala rasool bhej diya hai jaisay kay hum ney Firaun kay pass rasool bheja tha
To Firaun ney uss rasool ki na-farmani ki to hum ney ussay sakht (wabaal ki) pakar mein pakar liya
Tum agar kafir rahey to uss din kaisay panah pao gay jo din bachon ko boorha kerdey ga
Jiss din aasman phat jaye ga Allah Taalaa ka yeh wada ho ker hi rehney wala hai
Be-shak yeh naseehat hai pus jo chahaye apney rab ki taraf raah ikhtiyar keray

Aap ka rab bakhoobi janta hai kay aap aur aap kay sath kay logon ki aik jamat qareeb do tehaee raat kay aur aadhi raat kay aur aik tehaee raat kay tahajjud parhti hai aur raat din ka poora andaza Allah Taalaa ko hi hai, woh (khoob) janta hai kay tum ussay hergiz na nibha sako gay pus uss ney tum per meharbani ki lehaza jitna Quran parhna tumharay liye aasan ho itna hi parho, woh janta hai kay tum mein baaz beemar bhi hun gay, baaz doosray zamin mein chal phir ker Allah Taalaa ka fazal (yani rozi bhi) talash keren gay aur kuch log Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad bhi keren gay, so tum ba aasani jitna Quran parh sako parho aur namaz ki pabandi rakho aur zakat detay raha kero aur Allah Taalaa ko acha qarz do. Aur jo neki tum apney liye aagay bhejo gay ussay Allah Taalaa kay haan behtar say behtar aur sawab mein boht ziyadah pao gay Allah Taalaa say moafi mangtay raho. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai
